“————”

No. This matters.

I made the decision myself. I cannot leave it to someone else, and it would be dishonest if I were not the one to tell Sakura.
pages.mirrorMoon:

”
No, this is an important matter.
I can’t let other people handle it when it was my idea in the first place. It’s not in good faith if I don’t ask her myself.

pages.ja:
……と。
タイミングよく玄関の呼び鈴が鳴った。
「お邪魔しまーす」
桜の声がする。
こういうのは早い方がいいし、さっそく桜に切り出そう。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
And then—

the doorbell rings at the perfect moment.

“Excuse me.”

Sakura’s voice comes from the entrance.

The sooner this is done, the better. I will raise the subject immediately.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…Oh.
I hear the doorbell.
“Excuse me.”
I hear Sakura’s
voice.
voice from the entrance.
I guess I should strike while the iron’s hot and go ask her right now.

pages.ja:
「あ、先輩。お邪魔しますね、夕食の支度はこれからですか？」
「ああ、これからだ。今日は俺が一人でやるから桜はのんびりしてていいぞ。そのかわり藤ねえの相手でもしてやってくれ。セイバーに負かされて自信喪失してるんで、トランプか何かで追い討ちを頼む」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Ah, Shirou. Excuse me. Have you started making dinner yet?”

“No, I’m just about to. I’ll handle it alone today, so you can relax. Keep Fuji company instead. Saber defeated her and shattered her confidence, so finish her off with cards or something.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh, hello, Senpai. Are you about to cook dinner?”
“Yeah. I’m going to cook by myself today, so you can relax. But please look after Fuji-nee. She lost confidence in herself because Saber beat her mercilessly. Try to finish her off and play something like cards with her.”

pages.ja:
「あ、先輩ひどいんだ。藤村先生、今日タイヘンだったんですよ？」
「……あー、そんなコト言ってたな……じゃあ路線変更して、将棋あたりでなんとか」
pages.jaRuby:
「あ、先輩ひどいんだ。藤村先生、今日タイヘンだったんですよ？」
「……あー、そんなコト言ってたな……じゃあ路線変更して、将棋あたりでなんとか」
pages.en:
“Shirou, that’s terrible. Ms. Fujimura had an awful day today, you know?”

“Ah… she did mention something about that. Then change of plans. Try to restore her confidence with a game of shogi.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh, that’s terrible, Senpai. Today was a hard day for Fujimura-sensei.”
“…Oh yeah, she did mention something about that. Then play shogi with her.”

pages.ja:
「将棋ですね。はい、それなら藤村先生の独壇場です。
わたしじゃ飛車抜きのハンデもらってもこてんぱんだから、丁度いいと思います」
pages.jaRuby:
「将棋ですね。はい、それなら藤村先生の独壇場です。
わたしじゃ飛車抜きのハンデもらってもこてんぱんだから、丁度いいと思います」
pages.en:
“Shogi. Yes, Ms. Fujimura reigns supreme there.

“She crushes me even when she gives up her rook as a handicap, so that should be perfect.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shogi, huh? Okay, Fujimura-sensei is the master at that.
She beats me even when she gives me a handicap.”

pages.ja:
桜は上機嫌だ。
顔の腫れもひいているようだし、朝の暗い翳りはまったくない。
うん、話を切り出すにはちょうどいい。

pages.en:
Sakura is in high spirits.

The swelling in her face appears to have subsided, and none of this morning’s darkness remains.

Good. This is the perfect time to ask.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Sakura’s in a good mood.
Her bruise appears to be healing, and her earlier gloominess seems to have disappeared.
Yeah, this is a good time to ask.

pages.ja:
「で、桜。唐突だけど、今日からうちに泊まってけ」
「え
泊まれって、先輩……？」
「しばらく間桐の家には帰るなってコトだ。期間は、そうだな……出来れば一週間ぐらいいてほしい。あ、藤ねえには許可とってあるからな」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Sakura. This is sudden, but I want you to stay here beginning tonight.”

“What—stay here, Shirou…?”

“I mean I don’t want you going back to the Matou house for a while. I’d like you to remain for… let’s say a week, if possible. Oh, and Fuji has already agreed.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“So, Sakura. I know it’s a bit sudden, but could you stay over at my place starting tonight?”
“Huh
? Stay over at your place…?”
“I’m telling you not to go back to the Matou household for a while. Let’s see… I want you to stay over for like a week. Oh, I already got Fuji-nee’s approval.”

pages.ja:
「………………」
……桜の顔がこわばる。
桜は俺の顔ではなく、心を探るように、静かな眼差しを向けてきた。
pages.jaRuby:
「………………」
……桜の顔がこわばる。
桜は俺の顔ではなく、心を探るように、静かな眼差しを向けてきた。
pages.en:
“………………”

…Sakura’s face stiffens.

She is not looking at my expression. Her quiet gaze seems to search my heart.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
Sakura’s face stiffens.
She stares at me, as if peering into my mind.

pages.ja:
「
無理を言っているのはわかってる。けど、桜にはどうしても泊まって貰う。どう思われてもいいから、しばらく家で暮らしてくれ」
pages.jaRuby:
「
無理を言っているのはわかってる。けど、桜にはどうしても泊まって貰う。どう思われてもいいから、しばらく[ruby text=うち]家で暮らしてくれ」
pages.en: “—I know I’m asking too much. But I need you to stay. You can think whatever you like of me—just live here for a while.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
I know I’m being unreasonable. But I’ll have you stay over no matter what. I don’t care what you think of me, but please stay at my place for a while.”

」

じっと俺を見つめたまま、微かに唇をかみ締めた後、
「
どうしてですか？」
静かに、そんな疑問を口にした。

pages.en:
“————”

Sakura does not answer.

She watches me, biting her lip faintly. Then—

“—Why?”

She asks the question in a quiet voice.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
Sakura doesn’t answer.
She stares at me silently…
“
Why is that?”
…And then asks me that question.

pages.ja:
「………………」
理由は言えない。
慎二がマスターだから、なんて死んでも言えないし、他の言葉は全て嘘になる。
生きてる以上、隠し事は必ずある。
俺だって男だし、桜と藤ねえに言えないコトなんて、それこそ山ほどある。
pages.jaRuby:
「………………」

pages.en:
“………………”

I cannot tell her the reason.

I would sooner die than say it is because Shinji was a Master, and anything else would be a lie.

As long as a person lives, there will always be things they conceal.

I am a man too. There are countless things I could never tell Sakura or Fuji.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
I can’t tell her why.
I can’t tell her that Shinji’s a Master, and anything else would just be a lie.
Everyone has their secrets.
I’m a guy, so I have many secrets I can’t tell Fuji-nee or Sakura.

pages.ja:
……どんなに大切な相手でも、口に出来ない事はあるのだ。
だからこそ、嘘だけはつけなかった。
桜が大切な家族なら、言葉で偽るような真似はしちゃいけない。
pages.jaRuby:
……どんなに大切な相手でも、口に出来ない事はあるのだ。
だからこそ、嘘だけはつけなかった。
桜が大切な家族なら、言葉で偽るような真似はしちゃいけない。
pages.en:
…However precious someone may be, there are things one cannot say aloud.

That is precisely why I cannot lie.

If Sakura is family, I must not deceive her with false words.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…There are things you just can’t say, not even to the people most important to you.
But that’s also why I can’t lie.
Sakura’s an important family member to me, so I can’t lie to her.

pages.ja:
「………………」
空気が冷めていく。
このまま永遠に続くかのような沈黙と、気まずそうに目を伏せる桜。
そんな桜にどう答えるべきか、出来の悪い頭で必死に考える。
pages.jaRuby:
「………………」

そんな桜にどう答えるべきか、出来の悪い頭で必死に考える。
pages.en:
“………………”

The warmth drains from the air.

Silence stretches as though it might last forever. Sakura lowers her eyes uncomfortably.

With my inadequate mind, I search desperately for the answer I should give her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
The air feels like it’s freezing over.
The silence seems to last forever, and Sakura hangs her head awkwardly.
I put my stupid brain to work, trying to come up with something to say.

pages.ja:
「桜。理由は言わなくちゃダメか」
桜は答えない。
ただ、自分ではなく、まるで俺を案ずるような目をして、
「……わたしが心配だからですか？」
そう、はっきりと口にした。
pages.jaRuby:
「桜。理由は言わなくちゃダメか」

pages.en:
“Sakura. Do I have to tell you why?”

Sakura does not answer.

She looks not afraid for herself, but concerned for me.

“…Is it because you’re worried about me?”

She gives the thought clear voice.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Do I really have to tell you, Sakura?”
She doesn’t respond.
Instead, she just looks at me with a concerned expression.
“…Is it because you’re worried about me?”
And she clearly states this.

pages.ja:
「
うん、桜が心配だ。だから、桜がここにいてくれると助かる」
……長い黒髪が揺れる。
桜は俺の足りない答えに頷いて、
言葉ではなく、その笑顔で応えてくれた。
pages.jaRuby:
「
うん、桜が心配だ。だから、桜がここにいてくれると助かる」
……長い黒髪が揺れる。
桜は俺の足りない答えに頷いて、
言葉ではなく、その笑顔で応えてくれた。
pages.en:
“—Yes. I’m worried about you. It would put my mind at ease if you stayed here.”

…Her long black hair sways.

Sakura nods at my insufficient answer,

and responds not with words, but with her smile.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Yeah, I’m worried about you. It’ll help me out if you stay here.”
…Her long hair sways.
Sakura nods in response…
…She answers not with her words, but with a brilliant smile.
